structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A calm evening skincare ritual supports the skin’s natural nighttime recovery and is an essential part of regular care.
structured_intent.primary_action: The woman lowers her raised hand away from her cheek while continuing to hold the open skincare jar.
structured_intent.terminal_state: Her lowered hand rests near her lap while she calmly looks toward the mirror and continues holding the open jar visibly.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: She remains serene and intentionally engaged in her evening skincare routine, with the product visible through the final frame.

prompt.positive: She steadily lowers her raised hand from beside her cheek toward her lap, maintaining a calm gaze into the mirror while the open skincare jar stays visible in her other hand. Fixed camera; she ends composed with the lowered hand at rest.
